title: Force TLP battery mode
summary: Forces TLP to apply battery-saving settings even if the laptop is plugged into AC power. Useful for testing battery profiles or limiting performance while charging.

steps.explain: Apply TLP's battery-specific settings, ignoring the fact that the laptop might be plugged in.

rollback.explain: Run 'sudo tlp ac' to switch back to AC power settings, or 'sudo tlp start' to let TLP decide based on the actual power source.

warnings: This may reduce performance significantly while plugged in.
